text:
Hello night team,
Water breaks came up after dinner, so just a quick note

I want to thank everyone for the steady care shown across the Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways. The recent reviews have stayed focused on passenger comfort and animal welfare, and that is exactly the right approach. When guidance is given clearly before departure, most concerns are eased early, and the team can keep the process calm and orderly. Please continue to use the standard check points and keep your language reassuring, especially when travelers are anxious about their companions.

For the larger dog cases, <<FACT F063>> Please place the inserted guidance into the record without adding commentary, and keep the surrounding conversation concise. The aim is to preserve accuracy while avoiding confusion for the traveler and the welfare coordinator. If a case becomes complicated, move through the usual escalation steps one at a time and make sure the handoff is complete before closing the file.

For reptile bookings, <<FACT F060>> Kindly keep that detail visible in the notes and ensure the traveler is reminded in a calm, factual way. Sasha, if mentioned, should be handled with the same steady attention as any other pet, with care given to carrier condition, comfort, and documentation. Thank you for maintaining this careful standard and for supporting safe travel for every animal in our care.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
